content: generateMetadata alternates field shape: { canonical: string, languages: { 'en': url, 'ar': url, 'x-default': url } }. Requires metadataBase (new URL(...)) set once in root layout so relative paths resolve to absolute URLs; without it, relative alternates.languages values cause a Next.js build error. Renders as <link rel=canonical> and <link rel=alternate hreflang=X> tags in <head>.
